groups.title: Golden instances
groups.description: Small symmetric instances ($t \le 5$) whose fronts were also computed by the brute-force oracle (`tests/oracle`); zeno's regression tests compare against them. The `-C`/`-D` suffix of a name is historical: the arguments are what zeno runs.

groups.title: n = t, two planes
groups.description: $n = t$ cities and passengers, $p = 2$, default generator.

groups.title: Quick suite
groups.description: The short suite run on every pull request.

groups.title: Regimes
groups.description: Many cities and few passengers; balanced; $p$ close to $t$; medium; large. Default generator ($c_i = i$, $d_i = n + 1 - i$).

groups.title: Generator families
groups.description: $n = 10$, $t = 8$, $p = 3$. `-C`/`-D`: 1 log, 2 sqrt, 3 identity, 4 power of two, 5 staircase; `-r` scales before truncation to integers.

groups.title: Adversarial
groups.description: Instances where greedy rules fail or search is hard: the LPT counterexample, clustered and near-equal durations, multiples, and a 3-Partition gadget (12 cities forming four triples of sum 100, $t = 8$, $p = 4$).

groups.title: Scaling: distinct durations
groups.description: Number of distinct durations among $n = 24$ cities, $t = 8$, $p = 3$.

groups.title: Metric instances
groups.description: Points drawn at random (seeded) in the plane or on a sphere; every flight lasts the distance between its ends, so central flights satisfy the triangle inequality. With `--hubs apart`, $C_I$ and $C_G$ are two points and the instance is non-symmetric.

instances.name: plane-n12t8p3
notes: central flights satisfy (AΔ), not (A1): the front is exact (Theorem 4.10, Corollary 4.12)

instances.name: plane-n20t12p4
notes: central flights satisfy (AΔ), not (A1): the front is exact (Theorem 4.10, Corollary 4.12)

instances.name: sphere-n12t8p3
instances.comment: Durations are great-circle distances in km, on a sphere of radius 6371 km.
notes: central flights satisfy (AΔ), not (A1): the front is exact (Theorem 4.10, Corollary 4.12)

instances.name: plane-apart-n6t5p2
instances.comment: Non-symmetric: the two hubs are two different points.
notes: warning: central flights violate (A1-NS), which every bound but lemma R needs (Theorem 6.1), so only lemma R counts below (whether (AΔ) suffices is open: Conjecture 6.7)
non-symmetric instance: 43 achieved points; fastest makespan not certified (its bound needs (A1-NS)); 0 of 42 gaps certified; the front is a bracket
